title: Dusk edit & runlog — PM
content:
Evening catch-up / brain-dump (quick).

Purpose: tidy PRD edits, capture follow-ups from sync, and lock first-pass launch checklist before tomorrow's engineering stand. Notes are messy — for my eyes first.

TODAY (quick timeline)
- 09:15 sync with Marisol: reviewed risk matrix for hosted rollout window.
- 11:00 design review with Juno: clarified error surface for streaming responses (UX fallback). Juno to provide microcopy by Mon.
- 14:00 infra deep-dive with Devon & Riley: confirmed autoscaler warm-up behavior under burst. Riley: SLOs look ok but need explicit circuit-breaker on cross-region fallback.
- 16:30 ad-hoc with Legal on data residency for EU customers — flagged one clause (encryption-at-rest key rotation) to add to Private onboarding checklist.

PRD edits TODOs (inline changes i made and items to finish)
- Update "Rollout strategy" section: split into staged-canary (5% -> 25% -> 100%) and emergency rollback steps. DONE (first draft).
- Acceptance criteria: add quantitative thresholds. Proposed: median P95 latency < 120ms for text-gen small models; error rate < 0.5% sustained across 10m windows. ACTION: get SRE signoff (Riley).
- Add migration note for existing API keys: behavior for pinned version when model variant changes. TODO: define exact semantics for "pin": keep old weights until explicit unpin? DEV asked for clarity (Devon).
- Add UX copy for streaming fallback (from design review). ACTION: Juno to deliver strings; I will slot them into PRD.
- Security appendix: include KMS integration notes + audit log sample. TODO: paste snippet from Legal email.

LAUNCH CHECKLIST — immediate items before code freeze
- [ ] Finalize canary traffic policy (config file and k8s annotation). Owner: Devon. Target: EOD 11/08.
- [ ] Canary metrics dashboard (latency, errors, cost per token). Owner: Observability team / Riley. Need dashboard link in PRD.
- [ ] Verify fallback model variants available in eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Owner: infra.
- [ ] Confirm DB migration backfill plan for usage-metering. Owner: Platform Eng (Liam).
- [ ] Legal sign-off on residency wording. Owner: me (Avery) to chase Legal.
- [ ] Compose customer-facing launch note draft. Owner: GTM; I will start skeleton.

STAKEHOLDER FOLLOW-UPS (who I need to ping)
- Marisol: double-check the risk thresholds you want for canary (5% vs 10%). Ping in morning.
- Devon: confirm the pin/unpin semantic doc or point me to a design note (Jira INF-4211).
- Riley: ask SRE to accept the proposed acceptance criteria or propose alternatives. Leave margin on P95.
- Juno: UX copy deadline Monday AM.
- Legal (Priya): need explicit text for KMS rotation and EU data flow. Follow-up email scheduled 11/08.

MEETING PREP for tomorrow engineering stand (5 bullets to cover)
1) Quick status: code feature-complete for model-routing; canary config pending.
2) Acceptance criteria proposal + ask for SRE thumbs-up.
3) Rollout timeline and rollback plan — explicit pause points at 5% and 25%.
4) Pin/unpin semantics question — block or unblock? need decision to finalize SDK docs.
5) Can someone volunteer to own post-launch incident runbook? (Riley suggested SRE lead + product on-call rotation).

NOTES TO SELF / loose thoughts
- Consider adding a preflight smoke test that runs a seeded prompt set (10 prompts) across variants to catch hallucination regressions. Could integrate with Redwood Optimize eval harness.
- Cost note: if canary picks larger batch sizes to save cost, ensure latency tradeoff is explicit in PRD.
- Potential 3rd-party: re-evaluate telemetry hotspotting if we add token-level cost breakdowns to the customer console (metrics delta).

SNIPPET (PRD language I wrote tonight — paste here so I don't lose it)
"Rollout and safety: Launch begins with a staged canary. Traffic will be diverted to the new runtime variant incrementally (5% -> 25% -> 100%) across two regions. At each stage, automated health checks verify latency (P95), error rates, and generation-quality heuristics from the seeded prompt set. If any metric crosses the configured threshold, traffic will auto-fallback to the previous variant and the rollout will be halted for triage. Manual override is always available to abort or roll back to the previous stable variant."

QA / unknowns to resolve before final PRD
- Who owns the seeded prompt set maintenance long term? (ops or product?)
- Exact format of the audit log sample Legal asked for.
- Are we comfortable with 120ms P95 target for small models on hosted? baseline looks like 100-110 historically but under burst it spikes; maybe 150ms safer.

QUICK ACTIONS (first thing in AM)
1) Slack Marisol re: canary percent.
2) Open INF-4211 and add comment with pin/unpin options.
3) Email Priya (Legal) the KMS snippet + ask for wording.
4) Drop UX copy placeholder into PRD where streaming fallback lives.

End of dump. Will clean and convert to final PRD tomorrow after stand.

— Avery
(day note: if the morning looks blocked, push canary to Tue 11/11 window)
